children: announced Friday the appointment of Gordon Muir as senior vice president and chief financial officer, effective January 1, 2027.
The company noted that Muir succeeds Chris Gropp, current SVP and CFO, who will retire, effective March 31, 2027.

Gropp will support the transition period starting January 1 through March 31, 2027, as Special Advisor, also reporting to Brady Ericson, president and chief executive officer, focusing on a smooth and well-coordinated transition of responsibilities.

The company noted that Gordon joined BorgWarner in 2007 and has been part of PHINIA since its spin-off in 2023. He currently serves as PHINIA's treasurer, with responsibility for treasury and investor relations, and has played a key role in the company's financial strategy and capital markets activities.

title: PHINIA appoints Treasurer Gordon Muir as CFO
